name: ubiquitin protein ligase E3 component n-recognin 5

function.text: UBR5 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase UBR5. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-ubiquitin ligase activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. It participates in DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling and protein polyubiquitination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Acute Myeloid Leukemia; Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Invasive Breast Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
